items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 122:1
items.html: In the second aspect of the world of Assiyah, the four lower [Sefirot] of Assiyah were in the place of the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut, and all of Yetzirah was in the place of ZA of Atzilut; then Yetzirah and Assiyah were back to back, like ZON back to back, for Assiyah clothed only from the Chazeh [chest] of Yetzirah and downward, back to back. (Item 87).
